_note: Paid creative-audio tier → fal model oracle for the sound plugin. The script carries NO model IDs/body shapes/url paths — it reads them here. Verify endpoints/prices/body+url shapes via fal docs before first real use. Each tier: model (fal endpoint), prompt_field (body key for the prompt), duration_field (body key for length, or null), duration_unit (seconds|ms — how the engine writes the duration into the body), output_url_path (jq path to the audio url), price, price_unit (per_second|per_minute|per_gen), default_duration (seconds).

standard.note: CassetteAI Music — ~$0.02/min, fast instrumental from a text prompt.

premium.note: ElevenLabs Music — ~$0.80/min, highest quality. Endpoint/body UNVERIFIED; confirm at first premium call (this oracle is the single edit point).

sfx.note: ElevenLabs Sound Effects v2 — ~$0.002/sec, short SFX from a text prompt.
